findings.issue: §15 marks Error and No access 'Not specified', but X8 (503), X5 (403, MSG-P4-002) and §1 specify them. The Empty row also ignores X6.
§18 omits TC-E2-041-15-ITG and -16-ITG, although the note says §18 lists the §16 cases.
The note says §16 has 14 test cases. It runs TC-E2-041-01-ITG to -16-ITG.
New AC6 repeats the rollback assertion already made by AC5, so BR7 has a duplicate criterion.
AC7 makes the response literally carry the 'Not specified' placeholder as a quoted payload, instead of saying the failure code is unspecified.
